_comment: Tasks, the long-running task tracker: the tunables of ../Sources/DiplomatCore/Tasks.swift, TasksStore.swift and TasksSync.swift. The Linux front-end reaches tasks only through the diplomat-core CLI (tasks-list, tasks-sync, tasks-edit) and reads this file itself for nothing but syncSecs, minSyncSecs and chunk (to bound how long tasks-sync may take).
_syncComment: syncSecs is the front-ends' sync period while at least one task is not archived; minSyncSecs is the floor it is clamped to. A sync is one batched gh api graphql call per chunk linked GitHub items (graphql/task-item.graphql), each fetching its newest commentsPerItem comments and reviews.
_statusComment: A task whose last activity (its newest event, kept on the task past the history's rotation) is more than staleDays old gets the stale reason.
_historyComment: Past maxLogBytes, events.jsonl keeps the newest whole lines that fit in half of it, and at least its newest line. tasks-list shows each task's newest historyLimit events. excerptChars bounds the one-line excerpt of a comment or Slack message. A Slack ping that names a task waits up to commsHoldSecs for Comms' triage before it joins the task's history without one, and every ping logged after it waits with it: Comms triages in batches, up to its flush interval after the ping.
_noteComment: A note's text longer than noteChars characters (Unicode code points) is refused, not cut: tasks-edit exits 1 saying so.
